name: Champagne
description: Prestige sparkling wine from the Champagne region, made by méthode champenoise with Chardonnay and Pinot grapes.
ingredients: a handful of fresh parsley, chopped
a generous spoonful of Gruyère cheese
a pinch of herbes de Provence
instructions: Combine the egg noodles and chicken stock in a saucepan, blender, or pitcher, stirring well.
Add the herbes de Provence and cognac, stirring gently so their flavor infuses the mixture.
Heat gently over low heat (or blend, or steep, depending on the drink) until well combined and fragrant, about 0 mins.
Strain through a fine sieve to remove any solids, if needed.
Sweeten to taste with Gruyère cheese, adjusting gradually until the balance feels right.
Chill in the refrigerator, or pour straight over ice, depending on whether it is served cold or hot.
Garnish with parsley just before serving.
tips: Serve in a chilled glass for the most refreshing result on a hot day.
If serving warm, gently reheat just before pouring rather than letting it come to a boil.
